title: Switching location while in bulk mode clears the ticks
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com, S2 shop. Location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. QAPL-B1 is stocked and active at both Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge; QAPL-T1 is active at Staging Heavy Duty.
custom_steps:
1. On /parts/inventory (Active tab) search QAPL, pick ⋮ > Deactivate parts and tick QAPL-B1 and QAPL-T1.
  2. Switch the location to Staging Lethbridge.
  3. Hover the Deactivate button if the bulk bar is still showing.
  4. Switch the location back to Staging Heavy Duty.
  5. Leave bulk mode with the X if it is on, and check the Active tab at both locations.
custom_expected:
1. Both rows are ticked; the bar reads "2 selected".
  2. The list reloads for Staging Lethbridge and no row is ticked, QAPL-B1 included; if the bulk bar still shows it reads "0 selected" and Deactivate is disabled.
  3. Deactivate is disabled and the tooltip reads "Tick the parts to deactivate" (if the mode had ended, no bar shows).
  4. The list reloads; QAPL-B1 and QAPL-T1 are not ticked.
  5. Nothing was changed: QAPL-B1 is still on Active at both locations and QAPL-T1 is still on Active at Staging Heavy Duty.
